offence_note: Accessory after the fact to murder; obstructing peace officer
sentence_quote: I do not consider that the sentence imposed has been shown to reflect any error in principle. I think leave to appeal was previously granted so I need not deal with that but I would dismiss this appeal from sentence.
note: Four year global sentence under appeal; dismissed.

offence_note: Dangerous driving causing death; impaired driving causing death
sentence_quote: While leave to appeal is granted, the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: Sentence of 6.5 years stands; ancillary orders not shown.

offence_note: Producing marijuana; possession for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: While I would grant leave to appeal from the fitness of the sentence imposed, I would dismiss the appeal.
note: Suspended sentence and two years probation upheld; mandatory minimum struck under s. 12.

offence_note: Bank robbery with handgun; use of firearm in robbery
sentence_quote: The sentence imposed, in my opinion, was, if anything, lenient, and most certainly, not manifestly excessive. I would decline to grant leave.
note: Five years robbery plus one year consecutive firearm; leave refused.

offence_note: Robbery and three breaches of probation
sentence_quote: Leave is granted; the appeal is allowed to the extent that the sentence is reduced to one of two years.
note: Total inferred as 2 years plus 3 months pre-trial custody at 2:1 credit; trial judge accepted unspecified mitigating factors.

sentence_quote: A fine of $2000 due by 03 December 2020;
note: Fine, 24 months probation with 100 hours community service, 24 month prohibition.

offence_note: Break and enter stealing handguns; possession of stolen and prohibited firearms
sentence_quote: The total sentence imposed is 40 months.
note: Court found no evidence offender is Indigenous; no Gladue considerations. Credit 751 days at 1.5:1.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual interference, trafficking, prostitution-related offences, 11 complainants
sentence_quote: The sentence imposed is 23 years. From this sentence I deduct five years and 26 days. Accordingly, the remaining sentence to be served is 17 years and 339 days.
note: Fines of $100 per count in lieu of surcharge; court found very few mitigating circumstances.

offence_note: Break and enter and theft at night
sentence_quote: I am of the view that leave should be granted in this case and that the sentence should be increased to one of three years.
note: Three years further plus one year credit gives effective four years; probation set aside.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence varied to a conditional sentence of two years less one day, subject to the agreed conditions attached, to be followed by two years probation
note: Short endorsement; offence not shown; fresh evidence compelling.
